english.title: Recklessly provide false information to fines officer re financial circumstances
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in providing a statement of your financial circumstances to a fines officer in response to a relevant request, recklessly provided a statement which was false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 48(1) and (2) of Schedule 5 to the Courts Act 2003.

english.notes: Time limit for prosecutions 2 years from date of commission of offence or 6 months from its first discovery, which ever ends first (Paragraph 48(6) Schedule 5)
